facts.business: The Company is engaged in trading activities.
key_risks: Funding risk: As the Company is only involved in trading activities, it may not be able to mobilize adequate funds, if any, in time.
Regulatory risk: Any change in Government / Regulators Policy / Rules / Regulations will require fresh compliances.
Foreign Currency risk: The Company is engaged in trading activities, which may lead to risk of less profit/loss on account of volatility in foreign currency exchange.
facts.related_party_note: According to the information and explanations given to us and based on our examination of the records of the Company, the transactions with related parties are in compliance with section 177 and section 188 of the Act, as applicable, and details of such transactions have been disclosed in the standalone Financial Statements as required by the applicable accounting standard.
